description: A powerful Rust library and CLI tool to unify and orchestrate multiple LLM, Agent and voice backends (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, ElevenLabs...) with a single, extensible API. Build, chain, evaluate, and serve complex multi-step AI workflows — including speech-to-text, text-to-speech, completions, vision, and reasoning.
